purpose_context: Felix currently scatters operator alerts across several ntfy topics with terse, cryptic bodies, so real failures are easy to miss and each alert costs a manual office2 investigation to decode. This mission builds the shared alert-bus substrate (library + CLI + bash shim) and migrates the worst-offending emitters onto it, so a failing Felix component clearly says what failed, when, how bad, and what to do — the observability foundation the rest of the Bedrock stabilization work depends on.
purpose_tldr: Consolidate Felix's fragmented alerts into one ntfy thread with a structured, self-explanatory message schema delivered through a single shared emit library.
